plainTranslation: A's mind meets B's feelings. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is keeping it too light. You may talk easily and still avoid the things that matter most. The connection can stay pleasant without becoming truly intimate if nobody brings the real feeling into the room.
advice: Open the door on purpose. Say what is actually going on. Ask the question that matters. This connection becomes comforting when both people stop circling the feeling and begin to meet it directly.
summaryShort: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety.
